coordinates.object_orientation: Head toward -Y, tail toward +Y, left/right across X; feet on Z=0. Side +X view is the primary diagnostic profile.

concept.reason: Primary holotype photograph, original anatomical descriptions and museum summary support silhouette. No extra generated reference images required.

specimen_basis: MCCM-LH 6666, near-complete articulated holotype; not a specimen replica
scope: Whole organism. Do not substitute a skull, slab or generic dinosaur.

scale.basis: Approximate total length in NHM profile and 2010 description, not a precise measurement of every part.

diagnostic_targets: Localized triangular dorsal elevation immediately before hips, generated by two especially elongated dorsal neural spines, NOT a full back-length Spinosaurus sail.
Long counterbalancing tapering tail, muscular hind limbs and short but visibly three-fingered grasping forelimbs.
Moderately elongate theropod head with subtle brow relief, not a crocodilian snout or a horned Ceratosaurus head.
Readable separated limbs and digits; anatomically continuous neck, torso, pelvis and tail rather than disconnected balls.
uncertainties: Soft-tissue thickness and outline of dorsal crest are unknown; use modest narrow triangular skin-covered crest as an explicitly artistic choice, not a proven thin sail.
Integument is not known over whole body. Neutral smooth faceted surface, no asserted all-over scaly pattern, no speculative elaborate feather fan.
Colour, stance and soft-tissue volumes are artistic. Do not copy fossil death pose or a skeletal mount as a life pose.
acceptance_checks: Full-body profile must read as a bipedal theropod with short localized pre-pelvic peak, not a continuous back sail.
Both feet with three main forward digits; arms with three distinct digits, palms inward rather than pronated.
No appendages floating or visibly interpenetrating at joints; tail held off ground; feet stable on ground.
All four fixed views, no extra sheet unless a specific defect needs proof.
Original geometry, no downloaded third-party mesh or photo textures.
handoff_contract: Maker uses this directory unchanged; report COMPLETE with actual paths/hash to root, then stop. No Drive upload or cleanup by maker. Root coordinates backup; retain local until successful integration and verified recovery.
